name: app-teal-stone-podium-real-estate-app-phone
title: Real Estate App on Teal Stone
whatItIs: A tilted phone with a green and yellow property search UI leaning on dark teal rocks, next to a ribbed-glass panel with the brand name and a leaf-house icon.
whatItMeans: Earthy teal and sunny yellow suggest home and nature. Ribbed glass and stone add tactile richness.
techniques: Ribbed glass panel with rotated brand text
Rock forms as a natural pedestal
Yellow CTA against dark green UI
App icon floating as a 3D tile
Palette matched between screen and scene

vocabulary.definition: A glass texture of vertical flutes that distorts what's behind it.
Rocks or organic objects used to support a product.
An app icon rendered as a 3D object beside the device.
